headline: 65-year-old man killed over football dispute in Narail
summary: Mostafa Kazi was allegedly hacked and beaten to death by a group of people following a clash during a local football match.
details: A 65-year-old man named Mostafa Kazi was allegedly hacked and beaten to death in the Maharag area of Narail Sadar upazila on Friday afternoon.
According to the victim's family and police, the conflict began during a football match between the villages of Bhadravila and Polaidanga on Monday afternoon.
Despite two attempts at mediation to resolve the dispute, the tension remained high between the two opposing groups.

Family members allege that Mostafa Kazi, who previously lived in Polaidanga, was ambushed and attacked by several people from the Bhadravila area while he was heading to the Bhadravila market on Friday.
Local residents rescued him and rushed him to Narail District Hospital, where the duty doctor declared him dead.
The incident has sparked tension in the local area, prompting police to deploy multiple units to maintain law and order.
Narail Sadar Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Ajay Kumar Kund stated that police are working to identify and arrest those involved in the killing.
caption:
A football match dispute turns fatal. A 65-year-old man was hacked to death in Narail.

A 65-year-old man named Mostafa Kazi was allegedly hacked and beaten to death in the Maharag area of Narail Sadar upazila on Friday afternoon.

According to the victim's family and police, the conflict began during a football match between the villages of Bhadravila and Polaidanga on Monday afternoon.

Despite two attempts at mediation to resolve the dispute, the tension remained high between the two opposing groups.

Family members allege that Mostafa Kazi, who previously lived in Polaidanga, was ambushed and attacked by several people from the Bhadravila area while he was heading to the Bhadravila market on Friday.

Local residents rescued him and rushed him to Narail District Hospital, where the duty doctor declared him dead.

The incident has sparked tension in the local area, prompting police to deploy multiple units to maintain law and order.

Narail Sadar Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Ajay Kumar Kund stated that police are working to identify and arrest those involved in the killing.

#Narail #CrimeNews #Bangladesh #FootballDispute #Justice

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News, Prothom Alo

headline: DMP steps up security at World Cup big-screen venues in Dhaka
summary: Police are increasing surveillance to prevent fan enthusiasm from turning into violence following a fatal clash over football celebrations.
details: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP), including the Detective Branch (DB), will implement special surveillance at giant screen venues across the capital to ensure World Cup celebrations remain peaceful.
caption:
World Cup joy should not turn into tragedy. Dhaka police are stepping up security at big-screen venues after a fatal clash over football celebrations.

The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP), including the Detective Branch (DB), will implement special surveillance at giant screen venues across the capital to ensure World Cup celebrations remain peaceful.
